rows.grounds: kvacit (sometimes) + dhyānam (meditation), sandhi t->d before dh
japādi (japa and similar) + ca (and), sandhi c->ñ before c
kvacit with final t assimilated before c

items.question: How should meditation, japa, and chewing practice be alternated in ritual application?
items.inference: Ritual application alternates permitted meditation and japa with prohibited chewing.
uncertainties: mācaret may be a prohibitive optative; exact ritual context remains unclear.
items.plain_english: Sometimes meditation and japa and the like; sometimes chewing should not be practiced.
